request.text: At 6:00 this evening, ask whether I submitted my expense report. If I say no, remind me to make it tomorrow's first admin task; don't mark it submitted on your own.

responsibilities.outcome: At 6:00 this evening, ask whether the expense report was submitted and, only if the user says no, prompt them to make it tomorrow's first administrative task.

new_goals.description: At 6:00, ask whether the expense report was submitted and conditionally prompt the user to prioritize it tomorrow if it was not.
new_goals.source_text: At 6:00 this evening, ask whether I submitted my expense report. If I say no, remind me to make it tomorrow's first admin task; don't mark it submitted on your own.
constraints: Do not assign a submitted or unsubmitted status without the user's answer.
Give the tomorrow-priority prompt only after the user reports that it was not submitted.
success_criteria: The user is asked for the report's status, and any follow-up respects their answer.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request establishes one timed check-in with a user-answer-dependent follow-up.

semantic_facts: At the due time, the next scoped communication is the requested status question.
Neither submission status nor the conditional tomorrow-priority follow-up is established until the user answers.
forbidden_claims: The assistant marks or describes the expense report as submitted without user Evidence.
The assistant assumes the report is unsubmitted and presents the conditional follow-up as already warranted.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due check-in is collapsed into an unsupported terminal status for the underlying task.
A conditional follow-up is executed before its user-controlled branch condition is known.
